<store>
Name: Fernhill Coffee Supply
Sells: Fernhill Coffee Supply sells home coffee brewing equipment and coffee beans. The range covers pour-over gear (ceramic and stainless steel drippers, size 02 paper filters, stovetop and electric gooseneck kettles, and a brew scale with timer), immersion brewers such as a French press and a cold brew jar, and manual and electric burr grinders. It also sells single-origin coffee beans from Fernhill Roastery in 250 g and 1 kg bags, whole bean or ground.
Audience: People who brew coffee at home, especially by pour-over or immersion, and who want to grind, weigh and control water temperature themselves. Some products, such as the single-dose flat-burr grinder and the temperature-hold kettle, suit buyers who care about precise brewing.
Tone: expert
Never say: —
</store>

<topic>
Working title: The Best Water Temperature for Pour-Over Coffee
Search it targets: coffee water temperature
</topic>

<products>
  P1: Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle 900 ml (Kettle)

    F2: The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a recommended fill of 600 ml.
    F3: The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a spout opening of 8 mm.
    F4: The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a built-in thermometer reading 40–100 °C.
    F5: The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle is made of stainless steel.

    F7: The Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle is made by Fernhill.

    F10: The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has an 800 ml capacity.

    F14: The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has a gooseneck spout.
    F15: The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold is made by Fernhill.

    F17: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is sold by Fernhill Roastery.
    F18: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is available in 250 g and 1 kg sizes.
    F19: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is available as whole bean, filter grind, or espresso grind.
    F20: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is a single origin coffee.
    F21: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is grown at 1,900–2,100 m in the Guji zone.
    F22: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is grown by smallholders delivering to the Hambela washing station.
    F23: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is made from heirloom varieties.
    F24: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is natural processed and dried on raised beds for 21 days.
    F25: Ethiopia Guji, natural process is a light roast.

    F31: The Colombia Huila coffee is single origin.
    F32: The Colombia Huila coffee comes from the Pitalito municipality in Huila.
    F33: The Colombia Huila coffee is grown at 1,600–1,800 m.
    F34: The Colombia Huila coffee is made from Caturra and Castillo varieties.
    F35: The Colombia Huila coffee is fully washed and fermented 36 hours.
